jobs.title: Pricing Actuary
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to redefine insurance pricing and reserving through transparent, high-performance modeling technology.

Our SaaS platform uses transparent machine learning and predictive analytics to improve the speed, accuracy, and reliability of actuarial pricing and reserving.

Built by experienced actuarial, product, and R&D teams, Akur8’s proprietary algorithms enable insurers to generate insights up to 10x faster than traditional methods, while maintaining full explainability and regulatory confidence.

As our platform expands, we provide next-generation reserving capabilities, supporting an end-to-end approach to risk assessment and future claims anticipation.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 - Top 50 InsurTech Companies 2025

  • CNBC’s World Top 150 InsurTech Companies

  • InsurTech100 Global - 100 Most Innovative Insurtech Companies

  • Professional Equality Index (2025 score of 97/100)

With 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 400+ insurance clients on 4 continents, partnering with insurers in mature and highly regulated markets.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we evaluate all candidates fairly based on skills, experience, and professional merit.

Becoming an Pricing Actuary at Akur8 is the ideal opportunity to influence the usage of cutting edge advanced machine learning technology in the insurance industry and to have a visible effect on the product roadmap of one of the world’s foremost insurtech companies.

 

This position interacts with every team at Akur8 to various degrees: Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing, Engineering, and Leadership. You will be a subject matter expert and will act as a translator between all of these departments and the “language” of insurance, actuaries, and our clients. Externally, you will work with client contacts such as Heads of Pricing, Heads of Product, CTOs, Actuaries, and Data Scientists.

 

To be successful, a Pricing Actuary at Akur8 must be …

 

… a teacher. You will lead proof of concepts with potential clients. During this process, you will need to clearly communicate complex actuarial concepts to both highly technical and non-technical audiences.

… creative. Akur8’s software is extremely powerful for traditional actuarial tasks, but a Pricing Actuary is expected to think beyond traditional applications and identify creative approaches to use various Akur8 features to answer ad hoc actuarial questions.

… a problem solver. During check-in meetings with clients, you will assist clients by quickly diagnosing any misalignments between an actuary’s potential use of the software and the underlying assumptions behind Akur8.

… collaborative. You will work with our solution architect team to define scoping between actuaries and IT during migration of rates and deployment.

… a visionary. Akur8’s software is in a constant state of development, and feedback from the Actuarial team is essential to inform Akur8’s roadmap. A Pricing Actuary is expected to identify potential features or offerings that are beneficial to both the software and the industry, and work with our product team to best define the underlying problem and evaluate potential solutions.

 

Additionally, you’ll also contribute to white papers and present at conferences or webinars to establish the leadership of Akur8 in the United States and other markets.

 
 

Traveling is required for this role for approximately 5 working days per month (including team building trips to our Paris / North American offices, industry conferences, and onsite client meetings).

The successful candidate must meet each of the following criteria to be considered for this position:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in a P&C / General insurance pricing role, as a Pricing Actuary, Actuarial Consultant, or equivalent; prior exposure to commercial and specialty lines is an advantage

  • Broad insurance industry knowledge, including ISO products / ISO ERC

  • Demonstrated experience recommending and filing rates, including developing rate indications, applying measurement methods and state-specific adjustments, and introducing or updating rating variables and factors.

  • Experience across the rate filing and approval lifecycle, including responding to objections from state Departments of Insurance and avoiding common issues that can delay approval.

  • Hands-on experience in actuarial ratemaking and rate deployment within a P&C or general insurance pricing environment.

  • Ability to understand insurance business imperatives and translate them into practical, software-driven solutions.

  • Curiosity and the ability to quickly understand prospects’ and clients’ ratemaking processes, identify their key requirements, and map them to functionality within the Akur8 platform.

  • Ability to present ratemaking analyses and recommendations clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.

  • A basic understanding of Data Science and Machine Learning techniques for predictive modeling; given the nature of this role, no coding is required, though familiarity with Python or R is considered a strength.

  • Willingness and ability to travel for approximately one week per month, including visits to North American offices, client sites, and industry events

  • Native or near-native fluency in English

BONUS (attractive but not mandatory)

  • ACAS or FCAS credentials (or equivalent fellowship in a recognized actuarial body)

 
 
 

Preference will be given to applicants who can work from our New York office, but remote work is acceptable for strong applicants based anywhere in the Eastern or Central time zones.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

 

We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings.

 

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

 

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • Health insurance , Dental and Vision coverage (including spouse and family coverage)

  • 401K Company match

  • Life insurance

  • Cell Phone & Internet reimbursement

  • 25 days of PTO/year

  • Commuter benefit

  • Gym membership via ClassPass

  • IT equipment allowance

  • Professional development & trainings

  • Team fun: regular company gatherings and team events

As part of our recruitment process, we may carry out background checks in line with the applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the recruitment process. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by people. If you would like further information about how your data is processed, you can contact us at dpo@akur8.com.

jobs.title: Sales Executive Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems.

Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

With 40+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320+ clients across 4 continents while maintaining a strong engineering and product culture.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions.

As part of our growing sales team, you will be focusing, helping to develop and scale our business on the Japanese and South Korean market.

As Sales Executive, you will own Akur8’s commercial growth across Japan and South Korea. You will run your territory with the mindset of a business owner, taking responsibility for its strategy, pipeline, partnerships, customer relationships, and revenue performance.

You will develop a clear understanding of the insurance market in the region, identify where Akur8 can create the most value, and turn that insight into focused commercial action. This means knowing your territory in depth, recognising its strengths and gaps, and stepping back when needed to reassess priorities and redirect effort.

You will work independently while partnering closely with our wider sales, marketing, product, and leadership teams. You will also build and manage relationships with local sales partners who can extend our reach and support our growth in the market.

Your responsibilities

  • Own the Japanese and South Korean territory strategy, quota, pipeline, forecast, and sales priorities.

  • Build a clear market view across key segments, including large insurers, MGAs, and Insurtechs.

  • Identify the accounts and routes to market with the greatest growth potential.

  • Develop strong, long-term partnerships with strategic local partners.

  • Lead the full sales cycle, from opportunity creation to contract signature.

  • Build relationships with C-level and senior decision-makers, and communicate Akur8’s value clearly to different stakeholders.

  • Assess the performance of your territory, identify what is working and what is not, and adjust your approach accordingly.

  • Work with internal teams to bring market insight back into Akur8’s product, positioning, and go-to-market priorities.

  • Represent Akur8 in Japan, building awareness and credibility with relevant decision-makers.

  • Take ownership of outcomes, raise challenges early, and create new approaches when the existing playbook does not fit the market.

  • Engage and build strong relationships with existing clients to maximize the usage of the platform in order to create “happy clients” and to protect the existing contracts.

  • Lead the marketing initiatives with some support from the Marketing team in the headquarter including building marketing strategies, event organisation, contents localization.

You will be based in our Tokyo office. Travelling for business development events may be required in the country, and in our headquarter in Paris from time to time.

We are looking for a senior enterprise sales professional with a proven track record of selling complex software through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You know how to create opportunities from scratch, build trust with senior decision-makers, and turn a strategic account into a long-term commercial relationship.

Insurance experience is a strong advantage. Experience selling complex SaaS, deep-tech, data, analytics, or other mission-critical software is essential.

Required experience and capabilities

  • You have at least 8+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in enterprise software, complex SaaS, deep-tech with clear commercial responsibility.

  • You have managed long and complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including business sponsors, C-level executives, CTOs, IT teams, solution architects, procurement, risk, and legal.

  • You are a genuine new-business hunter. You enjoy opening doors, building a market from the ground up, and pursuing accounts where there is no existing relationship or established sales path.

  • You know how to explore the white spaces within a territory. You can identify overlooked segments, accounts, use cases, and internal stakeholders that could create new opportunities.

  • You can sell contracts ranging from €100k to €300k, as well as larger enterprise deals in the €1m to €1.2m range. You remain composed when the sales cycle becomes demanding and the level of scrutiny increases.

  • You can build a clear strategy for every major opportunity, with defined stakeholders, risks, next steps, decision criteria, and a realistic closing plan.

  • You understand the operating discipline required to deliver against a quota. You know how much pipeline you need, which opportunities are genuinely qualified, and how to maintain pipeline coverage of three to four times your annual target.

  • You are comfortable making accurate forecasts and updating your view when new information changes the probability or timing of a deal.

  • You have a strong land-and-expand mindset. You actively look for cross-sell and upsell opportunities, including additional modules, new teams, and new business units within existing accounts.

  • You are willing to ask for the internal introduction, pursue one more conversation, or challenge an initial scope when there is a credible business case.

  • You build relationships across an organisation, creating champions among the people who use, sponsor, influence, and approve the solution and build long-term relationships.

  • You combine ambition with commercial realism. You are willing to target major institutions while understanding the account coverage, sales activity, and pipeline creation required to win them.

  • You are comfortable discussing technical subjects and can make complex concepts clear to different audiences without oversimplifying them.

  • You are highly autonomous and able to take ownership of your territory, while working closely with sales, marketing, product, solutions, and leadership teams.

  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills in Japanese and English, with the executive presence needed to lead high-value commercial conversations. Korean as an additional language is a plus.

  • You are organised, disciplined, and comfortable working with CRM systems, structured sales processes, and regular forecasting routines.

  • You are curious, persistent, and action-oriented. You take responsibility for outcomes and keep momentum when a deal requires patience, creativity, or a change of approach.

  • You have the emotional ownership to solve clients’ business problems through technology.

What will set you apart

You will stand out if you have sold software into the insurance sector or another highly regulated industry. Experience with pricing, risk, actuarial, data, or analytics solutions would also be valuable, particularly where the product required both business and technical buy-in.

You will also stand out if you have already built a territory, created demand in a new market, or grown an initial customer relationship into a broader strategic partnership.

IMPORTANT: You must possess an employment status that will allow you to work from our Tokyo office.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings.

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • 20 days of PTO/year

  • Commuter benefit

  • IT equipment allowance

  • Professional development & trainings

  • Team fun: regular company gatherings and team events

As part of our recruitment process, we may carry out background checks in line with the applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the recruitment process. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by people. If you would like further information about how your data is processed, you can contact us at dpo@akur8.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Akur8 provides Life & Non-Life insurers with end to end software. Our platform uses transparent machine learning, so actuaries can build accurate models faster while keeping every result explainable to management and regulators.

Today we serve more than 400 insurance clients across four continents, from 8 offices worldwide. Our teams bring together over 50 nationalities, with deep experience in actuarial science, product development and R&D.

Akur8 in Japan. We have worked in the Japanese market since 2020, and our clients now include several major Japanese insurers. Our local team was established in 2023, and we are continuing to invest in Japan for the long term.

A stable, growing company. Akur8 completed a Series C funding round in 2024, since which point our revenue has doubled. Our work has been recognised by CB Insights' Insurtech 50, CNBC's World's Top InsurTech Companies and the InsurTech100.

As an Actuarial Data Scientist in our Tokyo office, you will occupy an actuarial function from day one. You will be the bridge between international actuarial practice and the Japanese market, working as a trusted technical partner to our clients.

Based in our Tokyo office, and collaborate internally with Sales, Product, R&D, Marketing and Engineering colleagues in Japan, Europe and North America. Externally, you will work with actuaries, data scientists, Heads of Pricing and Heads of Product at Japanese insurers.

This is a permanent, full-time position based in Tokyo.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your time will be split between client projects, support, technical modelling, product feedback, webinars, events and white papers.

Client projects and support

  • Lead proof-of-concept projects and technical meetings with Japanese insurers

  • Work alongside client actuarial teams to apply Akur8 within their modelling and ratemaking processes, including the use of GIROJ reference premiums and the requirements of FSA rate filings

  • Explain modelling approaches clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Technical modelling, product and expertise sharing

  • Bring international best practice to the Japanese market, from traditional GLMs to newer machine-learning methods

  • Collaborate with our Product team, and help shape improvements to the platform

  • Contribute to white papers and present at conferences and webinars in Japan and abroad

Travel. The role includes client visits, mainly in the Tokyo area, industry conferences, and a yearly visit to our Paris office to work with the wider team.

REQUIRED

  • At least 5 years of non-life rate-making or product experience in the Japanese market (8+ for Senior), at an insurer, consultancy or GIROJ

  • Hands-on ratemaking experience, such as rate revisions and loss ratio analysis, applying and adjusting GIROJ advisory pure premiums, expense loadings, and rating factor relativities

  • Solid statistical foundations and a working understanding of predictive modelling concepts (GLM/GAM), with the motivation to deepen them

  • Ability to translate client business and regulatory requirements into practical actuarial solutions

  • Strong communication skills, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences and leading client meetings

  • Native-level Japanese for client delivery

  • Business-level English, used daily: many colleagues are non-Japanese speakers, and the candidate must be comfortable interacting internally

WELCOME / NON-ESSENTIAL

These are great to have but not required. If you don’t meet them, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • Member of the Institute of Actuaries of Japan (Fellow, Associate or Research Fellow), or progress toward an equivalent international qualification (CAS, SOA, IFoA)

  • Hands-on GLM/GAM experience in insurance

  • Experience preparing or supporting rate and product filings with the FSA, and a working knowledge of the Japanese regulatory framework

  • Prior client-facing or consulting experience

  • Interest in reserving (IBNR) or life insurance




OUR TEAM

You will join our Tokyo team, supported by more than 200 actuarial and technical colleagues across the world who are keen to share their knowledge.

We value strong teamwork and a positive working environment. The team connects regularly through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke and occasional after-work gatherings.

As a reference for the Japanese market, you will help shape how Akur8 grows across the region, with ongoing professional development and training to support your career.

As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion.

 

We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. The team regularly connects through optional activities such as team lunches, sports, karaoke, or occasional after-work gatherings.

 

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • 20 days of PTO/year

  • Commuter benefit

  • IT equipment allowance

  • Professional development & trainings

  • Team fun: regular company gatherings and team events

As part of our recruitment process, we may carry out background checks in line with the applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Akur8 works with customers across multiple entities, currencies and billing processes. This role ensures that signed contracts are accurately reflected in our systems, invoices are issued on time and payment issues are followed up efficiently.

You will register each signed contract in Salesforce, create the corresponding customer and contract in Maxio, issue invoices and follow up on outstanding payments.

  • Reviewing signed contracts and amendments, comparing them with the information recorded in Salesforce and identifying specific cases such as prorated contracts, in-period upsells and terminations.

  • Issuing invoices and credit notes in Maxio and uploading them to customer portals such as Coupa and Ariba when required.

  • Reviewing automated annual indexation results, handling exceptions such as inflation caps or specific contractual clauses and ensuring updated values are reflected in Salesforce.

  • Contacting customers with overdue invoices and working with their accounting and procurement teams on purchase orders, portals and disputes.

  • Sharing payment delays with Sales Ops, supporting follow-up with the relevant sales teams and helping address the underlying causes.

  • Tracking the monthly accounts receivable ageing report, overdue balances and DSO.

  • Acting as the Finance point of contact for Salesforce data-entry rules, Salesforce to Maxio integration testing and recurring data discrepancies.

  • Identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated with Claude and other team tools, then supporting their implementation through to production.

  • Helping ensure that Maxio reports are reliable for FP&A forecasting, budgeting and financial models.

  • You have worked with contracts involving renewals, upsells, amendments and multiple currencies or entities.

  • You have experience with a CRM to billing system integration.

  • You understand the basic principles of revenue recognition.

  • You have knowledge of electronic invoicing requirements in France.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • You use Salesforce and a billing platform on a daily basis.

  • Experience with Maxio, Zuora, Chargebee or an equivalent tool is preferred.

  • You are comfortable working with contract, billing and payment data.

  • You understand how system integrations work and can identify inconsistencies between tools.

  • You have a practical automation mindset and look for ways to replace repetitive manual tasks with reliable controls or reports.

SOFT SKILLS

  • You are organized, thorough and comfortable managing detailed information.

  • You can identify issues early and follow them through to resolution.

  • You are comfortable challenging information when needed and communicating firmly while remaining tactful.

  • You take ownership of your work and can operate independently.

  • You communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders across different teams.

  • You are comfortable working across several topics and adapting to changing priorities.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills in both French & English and are happy working in a multicultural environment

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We are an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

ABOUT DEPLOY

Deploy is Akur8's rating engine and the final step in our end-to-end vision, where every step of pricing, from data analysis to modeling to ratemaking, sits in one modern software platform.

Deploy bridges two functions with different skills and perspectives: the actuarial side, which extracts insights from data and makes statistical business decisions, and the IT side, which maintains and productionalizes reliable systems. Handoffs between the two are slow today. Deploy removes them and increases speed to market.

Solving this takes a deep understanding of what IT teams and actuaries each need, and of the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing.

We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect to help insurance clients in North America and Latin America implement Deploy successfully. You will guide clients from technical discovery through onboarding, integration, and go-live.

LEADING DEPLOY IMPLEMENTATIONS

  • Own the technical outcome of complex Deploy engagements, or defined workstreams inside a larger program, from discovery through production, with the customer's team doing the build.

  • Act as the primary technical contact for insurers integrating Deploy with their policy administration system (PAS).

  • Coordinate across client IT teams, system integrators, and Akur8 product teams, and drive integration milestones with clear plans and transparent communication.

  • Isolate broken customer setups by inspecting payloads and log files, and escalate to Product or Engineering only with a developed working theory.

SUPPORTING PRE-SALES ENGAGEMENTS

  • Partner with Sales and Actuarial Data Scientists to qualify opportunities.

  • Lead technical discovery sessions on IT landscapes, data flows, and integration readiness.

  • Present integration architectures and deliver tailored product demonstrations.

  • Contribute technical input to statements of work and technical annexes.

BEING THE CLIENT'S TRUSTED PARTNER

  • Serve as the go-to technical contact throughout onboarding and delivery.

  • Run workshops, design reviews, and technical escalations in both English and Spanish, and produce customer-facing documentation in either language.

  • Review customer designs and help the customer team change them when they are wrong.

  • Identify project risks and blockers, plan mitigation with the customer, and bring in the right internal and external resources.

  • Enable customer technical teams to operate Deploy autonomously, with knowledge transfer and documentation in the customer's working language.

  • Turn problems found in your engagements into clear input for Product and Engineering, and close the loop once resolved.

  • Build reusable assets such as integration patterns, configuration guides, and troubleshooting playbooks.

  • Hands-on experience managing IT integrations in enterprise environments, including integrations between policy administration systems and rating or pricing engines.

  • Technical fluency (APIs, JSON, system design) and the ability to explain and defend how a rating engine behaves under a customer's actual configuration.

  • Familiarity with SaaS delivery models and onboarding processes.

  • Health insurance , Dental and Vision coverage (including spouse and family coverage)

  • 25 days of PTO/year

  • Professional development & trainings

  • Team fun: regular company gatherings and team events

These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.

Final hiring decisions are always made by people. If you would like further information about how your data is processed, you can contact us at dpo@akur8.com.

  • Leading user interviews to build a thorough understanding of end users’ challenges and objectives.

You will join the Pricing team, which builds the part of the Akur8 platform that Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners use to design, test and deploy their rates. Your mission is to scope, design and implement features that automate the rating process at insurance companies, from the first discussion of a client need to the feature running in production.

Much of the work is deciding what to build, not only building it. You will work with Product Managers, Designers, Actuaries and other Engineers to understand how insurers price risk, why they work the way they do, and where software can make them faster and more accurate. A good understanding of modelling, maths and logic is needed for this.

At its core, this is a hands-on software engineering role. You will spend significant time writing code, designing data models, building backend and frontend services, and ensuring the systems you ship are scalable, tested, and maintainable.

With AI being a reliable support for implementation, your main value will come from understanding the business context, the architecture and the data models as these will determine the quality of your deliveries. Our platform runs on AWS with Rust, Java, Python, and Angular. Prior experience with them is a plus.

You will work on the core of the platform from your first weeks and see the impact of your work on real clients.

In this role, you will:

  • Own product features end to end: clarify the need with the product team, scope it, design the solution, build it and follow it in production.

  • Turn requests from Actuaries, Underwriters and Product Owners into a clear scope, and challenge a requirement when a simpler solution meets the need.

  • Work in an AI native-engineering team: delegate implementation to deliver quickly, reviewing, test and own responsibility for everything you ship.

  • Balance delivery speed and robustness according to the client’s priorities.


Your work will help insurers price risk faster and more accurately, and will expand what Akur8 can offer its clients.

  • You have written code during your research and want to grow in software engineering practices such as testing, code review and system design, using AI coding assistants as part of your daily work.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity: you can take a loosely defined problem, structure it and move it forward without waiting for a step-by-step brief.

  • You take a pragmatic approach to writing code: you care about solving the actual problem rather than chasing perfection, and you can explain the trade-offs behind your technical choices.

  • You care about results more than about technology: you want to understand why a feature matters to the end user before deciding how to build it.


Prior experience with our tech stack (Rust, Java, Python, Angular, AWS) or the insurance space is welcome, but not required. We invest heavily in onboarding; what matters most is your curiosity and appetite to learn.
